children: Overview
Sweden digital savings platform's Q3 operating income grew 12% yr/yr, driven by all income streams
Q3 net income and EPS both rose 13% and 12% yr/yr, respectively
Company launched Avanza Sigma, expanding product offering to include asset management
Outlook
Company expects full-year cost increase of 9% excluding international expansion
Company lowers 2026 international expansion cost estimate to SEK 40 mln from SEK 50 mln
Avanza maintains SEK 120–150 mln total cost estimate for Danish launch period
Result Drivers
INCOME STREAMS - Co said Q3 operating income growth was mainly driven by net interest income, net fund commissions, and net currency-related income
PRODUCT EXPANSION - Launch of Avanza Sigma expanded product offering to asset management, contributing to operational performance
CUSTOMER ACTIVITY - Co said increased customer willingness to invest led to strong net purchases and record-high inflow to mutual funds
